'''Xan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he and [[Ki-Ta Kren]] were confronted at the ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'' by a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]], who sought to collect the bounty on [[Reneget Vause]]. Vause offered the Hunter to participate in the [[Blooding]] with him, and for Xan to joined his side. Kren initially survived the fight with the hunter, but Xan did not, and Kren died shortly after.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xan appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
